sn34.1:1.4: cattāro. idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na
sn34.1:1.5: samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti
sn34.1:1.6: na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti
sn34.1:1.7: na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca
sn34.1:1.8: hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca. tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca
sn34.1:1.9: pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā
sn34.1:1.10: navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati evameva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca
